## Description

"Control amplifier with module configuration.All input / output terminals of QUAD44are modularized and can be replaced as needed.Equipped with tilt control and base control, it can respond to changes in characteristics depending on the listening room and speakers.The tilt control adds gradual changes throughout the frequency band without changing the overall level.The base control consists of a LIFT position and a STEP position. description:
## Description

"Improved stereo power amplifier based on 405.The 405/ 2is based on the 405and has been improved to greatly increase the driving capability against load fluctuation.To solve the problems caused by the normal load line protection circuit, the QUAD has its own protection circuit, which smoothly reduces the abnormal current to within the safe operating range of the transistor and protects against short circuit. It is also integrated with the speaker protection circuit, which prevents the speaker from being destroyed by the trouble inside the amplifier.A current damping circuit developed by QUAD is adopted.This circuit consists of a single-output, small-power pure class A amplifier that amplifies voltage and supplies power for small signals, and a push-pull circuit with complete class B operation called a damper circuit. For small signals, current is supplied from the small-power pure class A amplifier to the load, and when the signal level increases, the damper circuit operates to supply a large current to the load.The low-power pure class A amplifier always detects and corrects errors between input and output signals and cancels all distortion at the output stage. In addition, it has low power loss, eliminates the need for idling adjustment, temperature compensation, and offset adjustment, and has excellent stability over time."
